title.narrative: USAID Cambodia Green Future Activity (formerly Natural Resource Management)

description.narrative: (Cambodia): The USAID Cambodia Green Future activity focuses on introducing communication approaches to drive social and behavioral change toward protecting and preserving biodiversity, wildlife, and forests. The activity aims to increase the knowledge and positive behaviors of target populations concerning the benefits provided by Cambodia's unique and endangered biodiversity and forest ecosystems and to strengthen citizen-led efforts to apply strategic communications to protect biodiversity and forest ecosystems in target areas..The activity supports the Administration's priority to promote climate security and resilience through the promoting knowledge exchange and behavior changes that address concerns related to unsustainable development, deforestation, wildlife trafficking as well as littering issues. Additionally, this activity supports the Indo-Pacific Framework and the Mission Objective 1 (CDCS DO1) "Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth Broadened.".
